name: SPT Energy Group Inc.
summary: SPT Energy Group Inc., founded in 1993 and headquartered in Beijing, is an investment holding company providing integrated oilfield services and products. Its customers are located in the Middle East, Canada, Singapore, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan and China. Its business falls into drilling, well completion and reservoir segments, from rigs, workovers and drilling fluids to stimulation tools and reservoir research, with smaller farming, trading, manufacturing and gas activities.
